name: 筹备
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE Slay the Spire 2 Power/status icon, transparent PNG, square. The supplied sheet is ONLY a style reference of actual shipped game icons; generate ONLY the requested new icon, no sheet, no labels. Match the sheet's strength, dexterity, accuracy and ritual: simple cartoon game pictogram, a VERY large bold compact silhouette filling ~86% of square, strong charcoal-black outline about 3.5% canvas width, handmade slightly irregular contour, flat saturated color, ONE large crisp shadow/highlight facet. Exactly 3 or 4 UNIFORM FLAT RGB fills with abrupt straight boundaries like the reference sword/shield. No beveled facets, soft shading, glossy edge, diffuse outline or gradients. Outline width is consistent, about 6px at 128px working size. Keep only 1 main motif. Extremely legible at 32px. Not app icon art: no badge, frame, rounded square, circular backdrop, pastel UI palette, photorealism, texture, gradient, 3D lighting, bloom, glow, noise, tiny lines, text, letters, numerals or watermark. Transparent exterior and interior holes. Center with equal clear margin. Approx 1024px canvas. Requested subject: 两颗尚未点亮的金星由一颗亮起的蓝白星牵引汇聚。 Meaning: 筹备. All main colored shape interiors MUST be fully opaque, no accidental transparency or cutout speckles. One dominant compact silhouette. Match native game's thick outline and big hard-edged two-tone color areas.
